item.name: 4. Subscriptions

request.description: ✅ STEP 4: Get available subscription plans (Public - no auth needed)

✅ STEP 5: Create a new subscription (visits will be auto-generated)

**Required Fields:**
- `plan` (string): Subscription plan - one of: `1_month`, `3_month`, `6_month`, `12_month`

**Optional Fields:**
- `start_date` (date): Start date of subscription (defaults to today)
- `end_date` (date): End date of subscription (auto-calculated if not provided)
- `amount` (decimal): Subscription amount in AED (auto-calculated from plan if not provided)
- `payment_status` (string): Payment status - one of: `pending`, `paid`, `failed`, `refunded`, `cancelled` (defaults to `pending`)
- `payment_reference` (string): Payment reference number (optional)
- `client_id` (integer): Client user ID (only admins can set this, defaults to authenticated user)
- `total_visits` (integer): Total number of visits (defaults to plan months)
- `completed_visits` (integer): Number of completed visits (defaults to 0)

**Note:** If `payment_status` is `paid` and `paid_at` is not provided, it will be automatically set to current timestamp.
✅ STEP 6: List all subscriptions (client sees own, admin sees all)
✅ STEP 7: Get subscription details with visits

Update subscription details

**Updatable Fields:**
- `start_date` (date): Update subscription start date
- `end_date` (date): Update subscription end date
- `payment_status` (string): Update payment status - one of: `pending`, `paid`, `failed`, `refunded`

**Note:** Only admins can update `payment_status`. Regular users can only update dates for their own subscriptions.

request.description:
✅ Create a new product (Admin only - requires admin role).

**Required Fields:**
- `name` (string, required)
- `price` (numeric, required, min: 0)

**Optional Fields:**
- `description` (string)
- `vendor` (string)
- `type` (string)
- `sku` (string, unique)
- `barcode` (string)
- `compare_at_price` (numeric)
- `cost_per_item` (numeric)
- `stock` (integer, default: 0)
- `status` (enum: draft, active, archived, default: draft)
- `track_quantity` (boolean, default: true)
- `allow_backorder` (boolean, default: false)
- `weight` (string)
- `weight_unit` (enum: kg, g, lb, oz, default: kg)
- `tags` (string)
- `meta_title` (string)
- `meta_description` (string)
- `handle` (string, unique, auto-generated from name if not provided)
- `requires_shipping` (boolean, default: true)
- `taxable` (boolean, default: true)
- `category_id` (integer, must exist in categories table)
- `image_urls` (array of strings) - For API requests
- `images` (array of files) - For multipart/form-data requests

**Note:** If `handle` is not provided, it will be auto-generated from the product name. The API supports both JSON with `image_urls` array and multipart/form-data with `images[]` file uploads.
